description: Figure 5, located on the right side of the figure, presents a line plot illustrating the sparsity ratio of SDPA output values below a threshold of 1e-3 after gating. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," ranges from 0 to 22 in increments of 5, representing the depth of the neural network layers. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, indicating the proportion of output values below the specified threshold. The plot includes three distinct lines: a blue dashed line representing the "sparsity ratio before gate," which remains relatively low and stable across all layers, with an average of 0.03; an orange dotted line for the "sparsity ratio after gate," which starts at a high value and decreases sharply before stabilizing around 0.2 to 0.3, with an average of 0.44; and a green solid line for the "sparsity ratio after average gate," which also starts high and decreases, stabilizing at a lower level than the "after gate" line, with an average of 0.33. The legend is positioned in the upper left corner of the plot area.
